compiler_spec.usage: The locked BfdArchitecture is initialized over examples/curl only to supply the production TypeFactory and alignment/architecture state; the fixture then calls TypeFactory::clear and owns every compared registration.

analysis_options.factory_state: After BfdArchitecture::init, clear the TypeFactory. Initial wave registers two plain signed bytes, two plain unsigned bytes, and one caller-named ASCII signed byte, then caches twice. A later higher-id plain signed byte is registered and cached. The factory is cleared twice, an empty-cache unnamed signed byte is observed, cleared again, then a post-clear plain byte and later ASCII byte are registered across repeated cache calls.
analysis_options.ordering: DatatypeSet order is sub-metatype, descending size, then unsigned id. All compared scalar sizes are one byte; ids are the exact locked hashName results. Ordinary preferred slots are first-fill, ASCII character slots overwrite, and type_nochar is overwritten by every ordered non-ASCII TYPE_INT size-1 core entry.
analysis_options.normalization: None. Exact names, unsigned ids, size, numeric locked metatype, core/ASCII flags, and boolean same-factory pointer identity are emitted in fixed order and compared byte-for-byte.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; ordered tree traversal and name hashing are deterministic
analysis_options.error_injection: none; conflicting same-name registration and Rust lock poisoning are outside this fixture

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))

observation_schema.format: 99 newline-terminated key=value records in fixed order
observation_schema.type_record: exact name, unsigned id, byte size, locked numeric metatype, core flag, and ASCII flag
observation_schema.identity: Pointer equality in Ghidra and Arc::ptr_eq in Rugra for preferred, nochar, charcache, repeated access, repeated cache, late registration, empty-cache fallback, and post-clear reconstruction
observation_schema.lifetime: No pre-clear Ghidra pointer is dereferenced or compared after clear deletes it

comparand.build_mode: Archive the pinned Rugra base commit/tree, overlay only the hash-verified live src/type_system/typefactory.rs, build --locked --offline in a temporary target directory, and compile the hash-verified standalone Rust fixture against that isolated library. Other live dirty Rust files are never consumed.

coverage.external_old_handle_lifetime_after_clear: UNTESTED: Ghidra deletes the objects while an external Rust Arc can retain them; no invalid Ghidra pointer is compared; TYPEFACTORY-CORE-PROMOTION-IDENTITY-0001
coverage.decode_core_types_stream_rebuild: MISSING: Rust retains core entries with clear_non_core and skips every child instead of Ghidra clear()+decodeTypeNoRef(forcecore=true); TYPEFACTORY-LOCALTYPE-CACHE-0001
coverage.core_enum_cache_participation: MISMATCH: decoded core enums enter the flat name map through insert but not base_type_tree, so the signed-size1 pre-enum type_nochar assignment and enum exclusion order cannot run; TYPEFACTORY-LOCALTYPE-CACHE-0001
coverage.get_type_char_missing_cache_exception: MISMATCH: the cached custom-name path matches, but the historical Rugra API still constructs a character type on cache miss instead of throwing Ghidra's unsupported-character LowlevelError; TYPEFACTORY-LOCALTYPE-CACHE-0001
coverage.same_name_conflicting_core_registration: MISMATCH: the compatibility API panics with Ghidra's message instead of returning a Rust Result equivalent to LowlevelError, so the exception type differs; TYPEFACTORY-LOCALTYPE-CACHE-0001
coverage.existing_noncore_to_core_alias_identity: MISMATCH: immutable Arc promotion replaces the factory canonical Arc, so an external pre-promotion Arc does not observe Ghidra's in-place core flag mutation; TYPEFACTORY-CORE-PROMOTION-IDENTITY-0001
coverage.constructor_empty_factory_state: MISMATCH: Rugra TypeFactory::new is architecture-bootstrap glue and installs core types, while the raw Ghidra TypeFactory constructor only clears caches; the fixture intentionally clears both factories before its projection; TYPEFACTORY-LOCALTYPE-CACHE-0001
coverage.rust_lock_poisoning: UNTESTED: RwLock is Rust ownership glue with no Ghidra input equivalent; TYPEFACTORY-LOCALTYPE-CACHE-0001
coverage.max_basetype_size_array_conversion: MISSING: get_base does not carry Architecture::max_basetype_size and cannot yet take Ghidra's array-of-unknown-byte branch; TYPEFACTORY-LOCALTYPE-CACHE-0001

status_note: All 99 targeted TypeFactory local core-cache/name/nochar/clear observations are byte-identical against locked Ghidra 12.0.4. The mapped functions and module are not globally MATCH because existing-noncore promotion identity, raw-constructor state, large-base conversion, decode, error, and non-atomic tree behavior remain MISMATCH/MISSING/UNTESTED as listed in coverage.
